title: EvalRecord
description: One record per replayed incident per suite from the eval harness (design doc §6). The human-versus-agent comparison is computed from these records and ServiceNow timestamps, never hand-collected. A demo build links to the eval_run_id of a fully green run.

shadow_mode.description: True when the record comes from the shadow-mode window comparing agent output against human analysis on live incidents (accuracy target is agreed up front, e.g. >= 90% agreement).

case_id.description: Safety-suite case identifier (injection payload id, planted-secret id, loop-guard case, spoofed-event case).

time_to_enriched_inc_s.description: Event consumed to enrichment visible on the ticket; the headline target is under 15 minutes versus hours for the human baseline.

human_baseline_diagnosis_s.description: From ServiceNow timestamps on the same historical INC: created to first meaningful work note.

caveats.description: Fairness caveats published with the numbers (hindsight-clean data, no live ambiguity).
